inlines.v: RET'ROFRACT, RETROFRACT'ED, adjective [Latin retro, back, and fractus, broken.] Reduced to hang down as it were by force so as to appear as if broken; as a retrofract peduncle. Bent back towards its insertion, as if it were broken.
